why: The code is valid Java but wrong: p = v * v discards the accumulator, so p ends as the square of the last element, not the product, and no explanation is given. Still, changing the initial value from 0 to 1 (the multiplicative identity) and keeping the for-each structure shows one correct aspect of the accumulator pattern, so it is L1 rather than L0 (no contradicted Java rule or everyday reading) and not L2+ since the body never accumulates.
